name: shellf
description: A small AT Protocol app built with TanStack Start and Cloudflare Workers.

scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run cf-typegen:check && npm test
scripts.deploy: npm run check && npm run build && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:dry-run: npm run check && npm run build && wrangler deploy --dry-run
scripts.cf-typegen: wrangler types && wrangler types --config wrangler.oauth.jsonc --env preview --env-interface OAuthPreviewEnv --include-runtime false --strict-vars false oauth-worker-configuration.d.ts
scripts.cf-typegen:check: wrangler types --check && wrangler types --config wrangler.oauth.jsonc --env preview --env-interface OAuthPreviewEnv --include-runtime false --strict-vars false --check oauth-worker-configuration.d.ts
